definitions.in_force: no incoming SUPERSEDES edge within the four indexed departments
definitions.dead_reference: citation whose target has an incoming SUPERSEDES edge
definitions.ROTTED: target superseded AFTER the citing GR was issued — silent decay
definitions.BORN_DEAD: target already superseded when the citing GR was issued
definitions.caveat: conservative by construction: supersession from outside these four departments, expiry by a GR's own terms, and silent supersession with no cancellation language are all invisible here and would only increase N
